modify.note: Process external-calendar cancellations and time changes through CalendarSyncService and the existing booking services. Filter incoming events to those associated with Cal.com bookings, resolve the booking safely from its UID, and skip malformed or missing references. For rescheduling, use the exported helpers to compare the event's start time, extract saved booking responses, merge updated event data, and construct the regular-booking service input; preserve existing response data that the calendar event does not replace. Check required owner, email, and event-type information before invoking the booking services, logging and skipping incomplete data. Catch processing failures with serialized error details so one bad event does not abort the sync operation. Add the described invocation, outcome, and duration metrics. Use the requested dynamic imports for booking-service and routing dependencies to keep webhook module initialization from loading the problematic UI dependency chain.
Mark booking references deleted regardless of the `skipCalendarSyncTaskCancellation` flag, because the external deletion has already happened.

add_edges.label: cancels booking from external deletion
add_edges.note: For cancellation, call the existing cancellation handler with `skipCalendarSyncTaskCancellation` so Cal.com updates its booking without trying to delete the external event again.

add_edges.label: reschedules booking from external time change
add_edges.note: For rescheduling, pass the constructed input with the original booking's `rescheduleUid` and use the existing idempotency service. Set the calendar-creation skip flag to avoid a sync loop. Reuse RegularBookingService rather than implementing a second booking mutation path, and keep this operation scoped to the affected booking.
